title: front-door-today — the AI page opens on a view showing Friday

set.request: mastermind cycle work: /framework/ai/ opens on the Now view, and Now shows the newest OWNER thread - which is from 2026-09-19, because the fast assistant is not running and nothing the owner said today became a card. The front door has been showing Friday all day.
steps: confirm the two counts: newest owner card, and how many cards are from today
decide how the front door stops showing stale content
build it, touching Now and at most the default view
test with no stored preference and with `now` stored
shot both at 1920 and 400, state the newest date visible
write the task page and land
set.outcome: **Now notices when its own heading is stale, instead of silently showing it as current — and the toolbar now agrees with what it shows.** Measured: the newest owner-authored card on `board.jsonl` is `o-172112` from 2026-09-19T17:21:12; every one of today's 27 cards is authored `mastermind`. Now still shows exactly one heard card plus its answers - untouched - but when that heard card is not from today and the board itself has something newer, a banner now says so in one sentence with one button, `Show today`, that switches the page to the timeline view and saves it as the new preference. The mastermind's own headless run confirmed the switch and the persistence both work, then caught one loose end: the tab strip kept reading `now` after the click, because its highlight was only ever painted once, at page build. Fixed - `paint_view_tabs()` now runs on every `redraw()`, so the tab strip follows the current view no matter what changed it (a direct tab click or the banner's button), not only the one path that used to repaint it. Works the same with no stored preference and with `now` stored. Chose this route over swapping the default view (fixes nothing for anyone who already has `now` saved) or making Now show the newest cards instead of the newest owner thread (a redesign the brief rules out) - full reasoning in this task's own `decision` line.
